content.title: Is Walmart Open on Easter 2026? Details on Holiday Hours
content.text: Spring has officially sprung and with it comes one of the biggest holidays of the year: Easter. Whatever you've got on the calendar for Sunday, April 5, you may have a few essentials to pick up at the store. Depending on where you plan to go shopping this weekend, you might be wondering if Walmart is open on Easter.Whether you need to swing by for last-minute groceries for your Easter gathering or Peter Cottontail forgot to deliver jelly beans, see below for the latest information on Walmart's Easter hours for 2026.Though Easter isn’t considered a federal holiday, it is recognized by a number of restaurants and businesses, many of which will be closed in observance of the day, including major stores like Target, Costco and Aldi.What about Walmart? To find out the retailer’s holiday hours, TODAY.com reached out and below you'll find everything you need to know to assure that this year’s Easter celebration goes off as planned. Even if you have no plans other than to indulge in a bit of retail therapy this Sunday, here’s everything to know on Walmart's Easter hours.Is Walmart Open on Easter 2026?If you're planning a trip to the retail giant this Easter, you’re in luck. Walmart will be open for business on Sunday, April 5.According to a spokesperson, Walmart stores will operate during normal business hours throughout the Easter weekend, which includes Easter Sunday.So, whether you need chocolate eggs or green beans for brunch, stores will be open. That said, certain locations may have adjusted hours, including Walmart stores in Maine, which are closed on Easter in accordance to state law.Because hours can vary by location, it's a good idea to confirm local times ahead of going. To find a Walmart near you or store hours, use the Walmart locator, which you'll find right here.Stores Open on Easter 2026Along with Walmart, see below for a sampling of stores that will be open on Sunday, April 5, or find a complete list here. BJ’s Wholesale Club: A majority of BJ’s clubs will be open on Easter Sunday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. BJ’s recommends confirming local hours before going. Find local hours here.Dollar General: Stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Home Depot: Stores are open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Hours may vary by location. Find local hours here.Kroger: A majority of stores will operate during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Trader Joe’s: Stores will be open during regular business hours. Find local hours here.Whole Foods: Stores are open until 6 p.m. Find local hours here.
